account_signals: By-design platform batch limit encountered (200 documents max per batch)
customer_reply:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out to Zycus Support. Regarding your issue with bulk approving 500 purchase orders at once: the eProcurement module has a built-in platform limit that restricts bulk approvals to a maximum of 200 documents per batch to protect system performance and audit trails (as outlined in KB-4859). 

Because this is an intentional platform design rather than a bug, the 'Approve' button is disabled when selecting more than 200. To resolve your immediate quarter-end requirement, please split your purchase orders into batches of 200 or fewer.

If you require a higher bulk limit for future business needs, we encourage you to log a formal feature request with our product team via the community portal.

Best regards,
Zycus Technical Support
internal_note: Customer reported a bug when trying to bulk approve 500 POs (Approve button greyed out). Per KB-4859, bulk approval accepts a maximum of 200 documents per batch by design. Categorized as feature_request / by-design limit, routed to product, P4 priority.
